function.description: Prepare a transfer intent (no broadcast). Returns intent ID for confirmation. Supports native tokens, ERC-20, and ERC-721 on any EVM chain. Solana: SOL + SPL tokens only (no pNFT/cNFT).
function.name: wallet_send_prepare

amountIn.description: Amount of the token to send (for native/ERC-20), or "1" for an ERC-721. In HUMAN decimal units (e.g. "1.5") — not wei, lamports, or any other base unit.

chain.description: Required for eip155. EVM chain ID or alias (e.g. 'polygon', '137', 'base'). Ignored for solana.

token.description: Token: 'native' for chain native, contract address for ERC-20, 'nft:{contract}:{tokenId}' for ERC-721. Solana: symbol or mint (SOL + SPL only, NFT not supported).

walletFamily.description: Which wallet FAMILY to act on — 'eip155' for your EVM wallet or 'solana' for your Solana wallet. This is a wallet family, not a chain: the EVM chain goes in `chain`.
